en.t: One day, auspicious snow fell thickly through the air.

units.source_text: 雪积得很厚了，晚来犹自不停。

en.t: The snow had already piled up deeply, and even by evening it still had not stopped.

units.source_text: 雪中苍松翠竹，各有风姿，夜景异常清幽。

en.t: In the snow, the dark pines and green bamboo each had their own grace, and the night scene was unusually quiet and pure.

units.source_text: 两人映着雪光，姿态更增艳丽。

en.t: Reflected in the snow light, the two of them looked even more splendid and beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“四季风物之中，春天的樱花，秋天的红叶，都可赏心悦目。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Among the sights of the four seasons, the cherry blossoms of spring and the red leaves of autumn are both pleasing to the heart and eye.

units.source_text: 但冬夜明月照积雪之景，虽无彩色，却反而沁人心肺，令人神游物外。

en.t: But the sight of a bright moon shining on accumulated snow on a winter night, though it has no color, instead sinks deeply into the heart and carries the spirit beyond the world.

units.source_text: 意味之浓厚与情趣之隽永，未有胜于此时者。

en.t: For depth of meaning and lasting charm, nothing surpasses this moment.

units.source_text: 古人说冬月五味，真乃浅薄之见。”

en.t: When the ancients said that the winter moon lacks flavor, that was truly a shallow view."
He then ordered the waiting women to roll up the blinds.

units.source_text: 但见月光普照，一白无际。

en.t: They saw only moonlight shining everywhere, an endless expanse of white.

units.source_text: 庭前木叶尽脱，萧条满目；溪水冻结不流，池面冰封如镜，景色十分凄艳！

en.t: Before the garden, all the leaves had fallen, filling the view with desolation; the stream was frozen and no longer flowed, and the pond was sealed in ice like a mirror, making the scene mournfully beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便命女童们走下庭中去滚雪球。

en.t: Prince Genji then told the young girls to go down into the garden and roll snowballs.

units.source_text: 许多娇小玲珑的女孩映着月光，景象异常鲜妍。

en.t: Many small, delicate girls shone in the moonlight, and the sight was exceptionally fresh and vivid.

units.source_text: 就中年龄较大而一向熟悉的几个女孩，身上随意不拘地披着各种各样的衫子，带子也胡乱系着，这值宿打扮也很娇媚。

en.t: Among them, several older girls who were long familiar had casually thrown on all sorts of robes and tied their sashes in a disorderly way, yet even this night-duty attire looked charming.

units.source_text: 最是那长长的垂发，衬着庭中的白雪，分外触目，鲜丽无比。

en.t: Most striking of all was their long flowing hair, set against the white snow in the garden, exceptionally eye-catching and incomparably bright.

units.source_text: 几个幼年的女童，欢天喜地，东奔西走，连扇子都掉落，那天真烂漫的姿态非常好看。

en.t: Several little girls, overjoyed, ran back and forth in every direction, even dropping their fans, and their innocent, carefree manner was very lovely to see.

units.source_text: 雪球已经滚得很大，女孩们还不肯罢休，更欲推动，可是气力不够了。

en.t: The snowball had already grown very large, but the girls still refused to stop and wanted to push it farther, though they no longer had enough strength.

units.source_text: 不曾下去的几个女童，挤在东面的边门口观看，笑着替她们着急。

en.t: The few girls who had not gone down crowded at the eastern side doorway to watch, laughing as they worried on the others' behalf.
